description_excerpt: Job Description WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON What you will focus on Join Gameloft’s Art team to create high-quality 3D characters and objects for our games, bringing artistic concepts to life while meeting technical requirements and production deadlines. You’ll work with different art styles, from realistic to stylized, ensuring every asset meets the project’s visual and technical standards. What it means on a daily basis • Create high-quality 3D assets: Model and texture characters and objects in realistic or stylized art styles, following the project's art direction and creative guidelines.…
